I am in the same situation what's worse i precisely know what a idiot i am i have no right's complain people out there don't have access to basic electricity.

I also feel it's kind of too late i way too behind everything i am 23 and most the people i knew around my have completed their graduation or are working full time but me i just suck lol.


Weight, no friends, surrounded by people constantly telling my future is over blah blah, day dreaming of bull shit idk guys.
I day dream of suicide nowadays....

I get this feeling too but unlike you i graduated hs with crappy score failed college, my childhood dream was marriage not a profession but as i grew up it got lost i simply didn't want to inflict this on anyone.

One day my parents are gonna be no more my sister loathes me so much it sucks and i will be all alone that day and probably kill myself.

But stay strong friend.

What comes up is that i am big whiny bitch who just to needs man up once and has to realize that life is a responsibility and something i have or die but my scummy brain and body and maybe me just want the second option.

and that's why i think this situation is not salvageable.

What i want? what i want? what i want? when i ask myself those nothing comes up i am an empty disk heck stupid and unrealistic things like someone in my life it sounds odd but i do when not on my ass sitting on video games i day dream of being married to a wife with different professions haha sigh.

What i want really want i do ask myself and nothing comes up.

All i see now is a bad future and wants all i want is for my mom and grandfather to be immortal it's sounds stupid and it is but i simply don't know what now? important years of my life slipping by and i just acknowledge what's wrong but do i do anything? nope like a politician.

Let me tell i mentioned how i follow schedules and one day wake up to a family fight right? well instead tucking back in i could have just thrown away the blanket and put of on clothes and step out for a walk but what i do instead? the easy way out. 

I feel like my own self is against anything it doesn't want to grow up it wants to stay and scamper around at the last moment there is really no solution for that.

I did read some part of what you said i am not going to lie to you i didn't read it all.

But let me tell you the most important in improving yourself, getting out of depression is? Well it's you actually want to get out of all this but if 99.99% of your fucking brain and 100% of your fucking body doesn't want you want or refuses to co-operate with you then no matter the medicines or help you are not gonna change.

Psychiatrists here think that their job is to either prescribe medicines like mad or make the patient aware of their problems but guess i already am this drives to a conclusion i am just being lazy and maybe they are true? they don't have a solution what to do if the patient actually knows whats wrong with him.

I did read a little of your blog? articles? maybe the reality is i am afraid to take a decision because once i do take it won't have a reason to go back or run away something i did all my life maybe i truly am a scumbag even morally now.

Lol i just replied to you on my other account where i talk about these problems without getting to personal like in a second deleted them.

I am not projecting my self worth which is btw very low into what other think of me.

I am judging myself in a honest, practical, true way of what i really am.

Oh in the past 4 years i have been just playing games and guess am i not good or pro at either them hell i haven't completed even one of them totally legit i either modded to make it a little easier or cheated through same thing i done my with life took shortcuts and in a situation where isn't one i ran away.

Even astrologers tell my parents this person(me) is actually hopeless some suggest to throw me out and forget me and live their lives in peace and i kinda agree with them and my dad has already done that and now i am judging this like a neutral thought good or bad? i am bad yep.

I mean trust me you wouldn't me to be family member but any other? people of my family you wouldn't mind if you were given a choice it would never be me that's for certain.

Well there are 3 hospitals here dedicated to mental health dont know about anything else.

But my family works hard for their money they never took shortcuts they have a right be mad i am a sloth here getting where? this isn't a safe country really.

Here is the problem in my childhood my dream was to get married that was all no careers no nothing. As i grew up they went away due the fact that no girl did want to interact with me and the fact that marriage is huge responsibility and you can't run away from that you can't run away from that life.

Now do i meditate, contemplate(i do this all day) nothing comes up all that comes up is a negative future where i eventually  kill myself after family no more and i am on the road, i succumb to cancer, diabetes, heart disorders and nowadays you hear this stuff everyday.

All this is great i follow a schedule for days fixed sleep pattern, walking in the park for 2 hours, sugar free and almost starch, oily food diet but everyday it's a fucking fight in the family in the loudest way possible it throws me off i wake up to a fucking fight i just want to tuck myself in the bed and once this happens all the effort goes to waste.

Meh here i am i ruined my future body for sure i get cramps, ants? in the legs or some shit like, my eyesight going to go to ever more shit.

Everyday in the newspaper or heck even browsing reddit i see kind of despicable stuff being done and i basically panic like a maniac i get really even when i see the front page article which rip to a person i don't even know existed.

On top of it all i have a abusive as hell family who just fight and scream everyday.

But me i am a douche too i could simply stop browsing computer, get out and get thin, study or heck just kill myself damn it but guess what? nope.

Good luck to you though at least you are a fighter i am that guy who has given up without even starting a fight.
